$Comment: Weakpoint node. Renders the ore item's own model and texture but is a real damageable entity, which a dropped item entity cannot be because those are intangible. The model and textures are bundled copies under Items/ because ModelAsset only accepts Characters/, NPC/, Items/ and VFX/ as roots while the vanilla ore art lives under Resources/. HitBox is the mesh's own bounds as the client draws it, measured by tools/measure_ore_model.py at 64 units/block. That is the grid an entity model renders on; this is block art, authored at 32, so it draws at half the size it was modelled at and measuring it at 32 gives a box twice too big. The variant's WeakpointScale grows it, and the spawner reads its centre back so a node sits on its socket instead of hovering above it.
